Naming residual trust makes a proposal read weaker than a proposal that does not. A document that says which obligations it fails to discharge is easier to reject than one that implies it discharges everything, so the honest framing raises the bar on its own acceptance — and the pressure is to state the limits quietly, or in a section a reviewer reaches last.
